prospective_rejections: Compilation and quality failures consume search effort; not included in replay budgets.
notes: Conceptual procedure. Compilation failures and quality rejections incur additional search costs.
Replay starts after compilation and quality validation; their costs are excluded from the reported test budgets.
caption: Prospective deployment selection and the retrospective evaluation used in this study. A prospective search constructs a candidate pool, applies graph preselection, and compiles and quality-validates candidates before throughput testing. The retrospective replay starts from already measured, quality-admissible paired cuts and evaluates the Bytes--Generic--Native sequence using their recorded throughputs. The prospective path is conceptual, not an evaluated search across every graph boundary. Paired detector combinations contain only three cuts.
